title: Database Management
pkEditHint: Primary key can't be changed while editing
deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this record? This action cannot be undone.
exportCsvHint: Export every matching record, not just this page
importCsvHint: Write a CSV into the current table. Merge is the default. You can switch to replace
importDescription: Write the file into "{table}". The header must use column names, the same as an exported CSV. Empty cells are written as null.
importFileTooLarge: CSV must be 32 MB or smaller
importModeMergeDesc: Match on the primary key. Existing keys are updated from the CSV. New keys are inserted. Other rows stay.
importModeReplaceDesc: Delete every existing row in this table, then write every row from the CSV.
importWillConfirm: After you continue, you must confirm 3 more times.
importConfirm1: You will import "{file}" into table "{table}". Mode: {mode}. This is confirmation 1.
importConfirm2Merge: Merge updates rows with the same primary key and inserts new rows. Rows that are not in the CSV stay in the table. This is confirmation 2.
importConfirm2Replace: Replace deletes every existing row in "{table}", then writes the CSV. Deleted rows cannot be restored from this page. This is confirmation 2.
importConfirm3: Type the table name "{table}" to finish confirmation 3. When it matches, Core writes to the database immediately.
importTableLabel: The display name is "{label}". Type the table name, not the display name.
